data.name: Eye of the Owl - Bosch VR
data.detailed_description:
Eye of the Owl - The Hieronymus Bosch VR experience. Enabling you to go back in time to the artist’s studio and explore his masterpiece, The Garden of Earthly Delights. This application gives you the tools to explore the painting on your own in otherwise impossible detail, while the artist himself describes the bizarre and mystifying scenes. The painting has been digitized in ultra-high resolution, you can see the brushstrokes and into the cracks. Use a virtual magnifying glass you hold in your hand to discern the faintest details. Activate the magic carpet shrink transformation to see the characters life size and even more detail.
See what you can discover about Bosch and his masterpiece.

Instructions

  • Only one controller is used

    Studio
    • Use the buttons on the magnifying glass controller
    • Info/Shrink - select an information point by seeing the info icon thru the magnifying glass, then pressing the Info button to shrink to the region
    • Zoom - Toggel magnification factor on mag glass (only available on the top studio level)
    • Timer - Displayed around the Info button when in shrink mode

    Keyboard
    • Space bar = Restart
    • D = Demo/Exhibition mode (shorter, only 3POIs)
    • X = Exit/Quit

Key Features

  • A virtual magnifying glass
You hold a magnifying glass in your hand and use it to magnify your view just like a real magnifying glass. Two different zoom levels available.

  • Ultra-high resolution painting detail
You can see brushstrokes, and even the cracks in the painting. This is the highest resolution painting or likely any VR object to date.

  • A painting soundscape
3D binaural sounds are positioned on the painting to alert the viewer to components in the scenes. Use headphones for 3D sound.

  • Shrinking the viewer
You can shrink on the magic carpet for more close up detail and see the characters in life size.

  • Vive Room Space
Ability to walk around and intimately examine this extraordinary painting.

  • Information
Narration from the latest art historian research

reviews.review:
[i]Win 7/64
Intel i7@3.9
16GB Ram
GTX 960/ 2GB
Oculus CV1 + Touch[/i]

[b]I love it[/b]

Wow, that thing is awesome. Bosch is one of my favourite Painters and honestly, i never had the Chance to look at one of his paintings in such a great Detail. The HighRes Photography is more than stunning. You can clearly see every little crack, every brushstroke, simply everything, as if you would stand right in front of it. 

Also the Atmosphere of the 3D Surrounding is great, with it´s lighting and it´s sounds. Sure, the Objects could be worked out more nicely but that´s not the point of the Software and all in all it gives you a nice VR Space to sit in. The Focus of course, stays on the Painting itself.

I have to admit that the "I" Buttons in the Picture, for more Infos on several parts of it, didn´t work for me. So i don´t know if it is buggy to me or wether i am missing out something to activate them correctly. Also the Shrinkmode... don´t know how to activate. Whatever i do with the I-Buttons... nothing really triggers them. Possibly it has to do with Oculus Sound/ Headphones, that i am not using.

Nevertheless, this Software is great and i would gladly pay good Money for that if it would contain more Artpieces, more Surroundings, just more of everything. I can honestly say that this is one of my favourite VR Experiences. So hey Devs... pls give me the 'Full Experience' of Bosch or even better: start a Series of great Artists. I will be for sure one of your first Customers.

Long Story short, fully recommended 10/10. I would subtract one point because of the (for me) nonworking Info Buttons and Shrink mode but i won´t do that, because the Software is free and it seems that others didn´t had that problem.

edit: Shrinkmode works like a charm. Had to press the Joy-Button down. Now the Experience is even nicer!
